name: drift_never_skips_a_check_twice
description: The pack the Drift leaves out of a window is never the one it left out of the window before (design 1.4): 200 draws of SimUndertow.draw_drift from three seeds each leave out a different pack than the draw before, every one of the four is left out at times, and every offer is three packs in CHECK_IDS order; in a duel played to window 12 the EV_DRIFT left-outs never repeat either.

steps.msg: each draw left out one pack, and every offer was three in order (no 'bad offer' rows)
no pack left out twice in a row

steps.assert: draws[0].has('swarm') and draws[0].has('swift') and draws[0].has('armored') and draws[0].has('winged')
steps.msg: every pack is left out at times
in a duel's eleven offers too
